figures.caption: The countdown halts with one live operand after 33 guest instructions.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels show the returned countdown. Native status is one and retired count is 33. Descriptor PC is 18, depth one, retired 33, status one, capacity eight, fault minus one and stack pointer 0x100100d4. Only the first operand word, six, is live. Caller result words remain 99.

figures.caption: Four retired guest instructions leave PC seven and two live operands.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels show a budget return. Status zero and retired count four agree with descriptor PC seven, depth two, retired four, status zero, capacity eight and fault minus one. Live operands are zero and three. A third physical cell still holds three but lies outside depth. Fuel is four and caller result words remain 99.

figures.caption: A failed duplicate retains the two pushes and does not retire.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels show capacity failure. Status minus six and retired count two agree with descriptor PC four, depth two, retired two, status minus six, capacity two and fault four. The live prefix zero, three is unchanged by the failed duplicate. Fuel is three and caller result words remain 99.

figures.caption: An invalid encoded target is rejected before a zero instruction budget.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels show branch-target validation failure before execution. Status minus three and retired count zero agree with descriptor PC zero, depth zero, retired zero, status minus three, capacity eight and fault five. The target operand at byte six is six and points into its own record. No operand is live; fuel is zero and caller result words remain 99.
